description: Planned Rust database connectivity library: one API and native drivers for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server and SQLite with JDBC, ODBC and ADBC parity and exports, and Arrow-native results. Design stage: research and build plan only, no released code.
rules: karez is in the design stage: there is no released crate, driver or benchmark result. Describe anything not built as planned or as a design target.
Do not invent karez API. The only API is the sketch in docs/design/plan.md section 2.5.
Numbers in docs/design/research.md are tagged [vendor], [third party] or [paper] with a check date; never rank numbers from different machines together.
Never claim karez is faster than another library until a benchmark that follows docs/design/plan.md section 6 supports it.
karez is not a fork of tokio-rs/rdbc and copies no code from it.
